{{Quote|&hellip; only through peace can I find the truth of what I must seek. I walk a long and difficult path, but I welcome the journey.|Sajar|<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />}}
'''Sajar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was known as '''Darth Sajar''' in his [[Time/Legends|time]] as a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and member of the ruling [[Dark Council]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. He attempted to trap and [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tol Braga]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], but Braga convinced Sajar to abandon the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and join the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Sajar renounced the Empire and his seat on the Council to become Braga's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], and he [[Jedi training/Legends|studied]] the ways of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] throughout the rest of the war and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

While Sajar was stationed on [[Quesh]] in [[3642 BBY]] to guard a [[Adrenal Research Base|military base]], he was caught in an [[Quesh war|Imperial invasion]]. Slipping back into the grasp of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] after killing several [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] and recognized by Imperial forces, Sajar decided to die a servant of the light at the hands of the [[Emperor's Wrath]], the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] personal executioner, rather than become a Sith once more. However, Sajar and the [[Republic trooper|troopers]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military's]] [[Eighty-sixth Infantry]] received reinforcements when Braga sent the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] to rescue Sajar. The Knight's efforts in the battle to save the base ensured that Sajar could return to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and receive redemption.

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|We dueled on Dantooine. Fought for three days. I won when I convinced him to abandon the dark side and train as a Jedi.|Tol Braga|<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] many [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before the end of the [[Great Galactic War]]<ref name="BirthDate" /> with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Sajar was powerful enough in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to become<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" /> [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sajar,<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jedi Master Tol Braga}}</ref> a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and a member of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] ruling [[Dark Council]].<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" /> During his tenure as a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] on the Council, Sajar learned of the existence of the [[Children of the Emperor]]&mdash;the agents who were unknowing extensions of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] will.<ref name="The Defector">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Defector|Abandoned Mining Facility}}</ref>

[[File:Tol_Braga.png|thumb|right|250px|Tol Braga, Sajar's Jedi Master]]
Sometime before the end of the war in [[3653 BBY]], Sajar lured the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tol Braga]] into a trap on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] by professing a desire for peace. The [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had contacted many [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] during the conflict in an attempt to start peace talks, and Sajar took advantage of that by attempting to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Jedi Master when he arrived.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The two [[Duel on Dantooine|dueled]] for a total of three [[Standard day/Legends|days]], debating the Force and their respective sides throughout the entire [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|fight]]. Their [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|fight]] ended when Braga convinced Sajar to abandon the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and join the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and the Sith Lord renounced his title to become Braga's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />

As Braga's student, Sajar [[Jedi training/Legends|studied]] the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] during the rest of the war and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] after sharing much of his knowledge of the Empire with the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" /> Among the information he gave the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Council]] was the existence of the Children, though their purpose or locations remained unknown to the Jedi.<ref name="The Defector" /> Sajar served as the inspiration for Braga's later [[Hunt for the Sith Emperor|mission]] to capture and redeem the Sith Emperor himself.<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />

===Incident on Quesh===
{{Quote|I can't save them and they won't retreat. What can I do? Fighting would accelerate my return to the dark side. I'd rather die with Jedi teachings in my heart.|Sajar, on the situation on Quesh|<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />}}
Sajar was still a Padawan<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" /> by [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates/2|here]], the events of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Act II storyline of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which includes the mission "The Emperor's Wrath," take place by [[3642 BBY]].</ref> by which [[Time/Legends|time]] Braga had sent him on an assignment from the Jedi [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] to guard the Republic's [[Adrenal Research Base]] on the planet [[Quesh]]. Quesh's [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenal]] production made the planet a vital Republic resource, but its peacefulness made it a viable place for Sajar to [[Meditation/Legends|meditate]] while also serving the Republic. The facility was guarded by a detachment from the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military's]] [[Eighty-sixth Infantry]] under [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gundo]].<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />

[[File:Adrenal_Research_Facility_In.png|thumb|left|300px|The Eighty-sixth Infantry under Sajar's command defend the Adrenal Research Base from Imperial forces.]]
However, that peace was shattered when the Empire [[Quesh war|invaded]], and Gundo's forces captured several Imperial [[Scout/Legends|scouts]]. The [[Republic trooper]]s turned the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] over to Sajar for interrogation, but the scouts angered the Padawan and caused his Sith personality to resurface. Sajar brutally murdered the defenseless and shackled prisoners and lied to Gundo and his men when they learned of their deaths. [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial forces]] soon arrived outside the cliffs within which the facility was located, and in a frenzy of anger, Sajar [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] hurled the scouts' corpses at his enemies. An [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Quesh)|Imperial officer]] recognized Sajar as the traitorous Darth Sajar and warned the former Sith that the [[Emperor's Wrath]]&mdash;the Sith Emperor's personal [[Immortality/Legends|immortal]] executioner and an individual whom even the Dark Council feared&mdash;was coming.<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />

Regaining control of himself, Sajar decided that he would rather die at the Wrath's hand than become Darth Sajar once more, and he refused to fight, knowing that doing so would cause him to return to the dark side. Bereft of Sajar's aid, Gundo ordered his men to prepare their defenses anyway, and Sajar ignored his Master's attempts to reach him via [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]]. Braga learned of the situation from Gundo and sent the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] to Quesh in order to rescue Sajar, and the despondent Padawan revealed the truth to the Hero upon the Knight's arrival.<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />

===Wrath and forgiveness===
{{GameLS}}
{{Quote|All this time living among Jedi, and I've learned nothing of forgiveness.|Sajar|<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />}}
When Gundo requested the Jedi's aid in defending the main entrance while his [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] jury-rigged a set of [[Ray shield generator/Legends|ray shield generators]], Sajar begged the Knight not to ask him to fight, and the Hero acknowledged the Padawan's request by ordering him to help the engineers set up the [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shields]]. While the Knight and a companion battled Imperial and Sith attackers and pushed them back to the facility's main entrance, Sajar worked with the Eighty-sixth's engineers to bring the ray [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] online, and with Sajar's help they were able to seal the base in half the time it would normally have taken. After the shields were activated, the Hero encountered [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]], the Emperor's Wrath, who showed interest in the Knight before departing and leaving Sajar to his own fate. Once the Hero returned, Sajar agreed with the other Jedi's suggestion that he return to Tython, with the Hero reminding the Padawan that Braga had sent aid because he cared for his student&mdash;and that he would forgive Sajar's actions if given the chance.<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />

True to his word, Sajar soon returned to Tython and informed the Council of the events on Quesh. He began his training anew on the Order's homeworld, shedding his guilt and remorse over his actions when he understood that they would only precipitate another fall to the dark side. He later sent a message to the Hero of Tython, thanking the Jedi for the chance at redemption and expressing his gratitude at being able to walk the path to the light once more.<ref name="A Second Chance">{{TORcite|type=message|A Second Chance|Sajar}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|This war&hellip; I wasn't ready. I never should've left Tython.|Sajar|<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />}}
[[File:Sajar_Quesh.png|thumb|right|250px|Sajar as a Jedi Padawan]]
Light-skinned with [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and short-cut brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]], Sajar was greatly defined by his time as both a Jedi and a Sith. As a Sith Lord and member of the Dark Council, Darth Sajar was charged with the protection of the Empire's civilization at all costs, and he would not hesitate to press the offensive or seize an advantage in order to eliminate a threat. Even Sajar himself acknowledged that he was ruthless and brutal in the treatment of his enemies as a Sith, and that trait prompted him to kill the Imperial scouts in what he described as a "slaughter" when his anger led to the resurfacing of his Sith personality.<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />

Upon hearing of Tol Braga's attempts to begin peace talks, Sajar saw an opportunity to eliminate a Jedi Master and took it, believing that Braga's desire for peace made him the weaker of the two.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> However, he was also a capable and intelligent individual who could engage in a serious and thought-provoking debate. Over the course of their three-day duel, Braga was able to convince the Dark Councilor to become a Jedi, and Sajar abandoned his title and use of the dark side to study under the Kel Dor.<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />

By the time of the Cold War, Sajar had come to greatly regret his actions as a Sith and wholeheartedly embraced the light side of the Force. Despite his training, however, he lost control of his emotions when confronted with the enemy and lost faith in his abilities and right to be a Jedi. Fear of the Emperor's Wrath brought him back to his senses, and the Padawan decided that it would be better to die a Jedi than become what he characterized as a "monster" again. At the Hero of Tython's urging,<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" /> Sajar returned to Tython and began training as a Jedi once more, letting go of his guilt under the instruction of the Masters at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. He was grateful for the chance to redeem himself and intended to walk the path to become a Jedi regardless of the difficulties ahead of him.<ref name="A Second Chance" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Sajar is no ordinary Padawan. He was once a Sith Lord. A member of the Empire's Dark Council.|Tol Braga|<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />}}
Darth Sajar spent decades as a Sith, and he excelled at channeling his hatred to strengthen himself in battle. However, as a Jedi, he embraced the light side of the Force and spent [[Standard year/Legends|years]] retraining himself under the guidance of Braga to abandon the ways of the Sith. Sajar was powerful in the use of the Force, and he demonstrated significant endurance and combat prowess when he dueled Braga for three days straight. Sajar also showed impressive familiarity with [[Computer/Legends|computers]] and engineering, helping a team of experienced [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] double their efficiency in setting up and activating jury-rigged ray shielding.<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />

==Equipment==
[[File:Sajar_saber.png|thumb|right|70px|Sajar's lightsaber]]
As a Jedi Padawan, Sajar utilized traditional [[Armor/Legends|unarmored]] [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] and a blue-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], though he refused to use it after his brief fall on Quesh in fear of becoming a Sith. He wielded his lightsaber with a two-handed grip, favoring overhead strikes and close-combat attacks.<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|That's it&mdash;we did it! With the ray shields up, we can hold out until reinforcements get here.''"<br />"''Then we kill our enemies. Yes. Destroy them to the last man. No&hellip; no. That's not&hellip; I told you! I shouldn't have done this!|Gundo and Sajar's dialogue if the player forces Sajar to fight|<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />}}
Sajar first appeared in the Jedi Knight mission "The Emperor's Wrath" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]] and released in [[2011]]. In the mission, Tol Braga sends the player to Quesh to investigate why Sajar is not responding to his communications, and the Knight is then forced to defend the research facility from an Imperial attack. The player can choose to force Sajar to fight for dark side alignment points, allow him to hide for light side points, or have him aid the engineers for additional light side points. If Sajar fights, he will aid the player in battling the Imperials and Sith in the base, though he runs away from the main entrance after realizing he is falling back to the dark side. After the battle, the player can then convince Sajar to return to Tython for more light side points or cover up Sajar's murder of the scouts for dark side points.<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" /> As a Republic character, the Jedi Knight is assumed to only choose the light side options, so this article assumes that the player has Sajar aid the engineers and return to Tython.

Sajar later sends a message to the player thanking them for either sending him to Tython or covering up the incident, depending on their choice.<ref name="A Second Chance" /> An earlier Jedi Knight mission, "The Defector," identifies Sajar as the source of the Jedi Council's information on the Children of the Emperor, though he is not mentioned by name.<ref name="The Defector" /> The [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' explains the backstory behind Sajar's duel with Braga in an entry on the Kel Dor Jedi, though it mistakenly places the duel on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] instead of Dantooine.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
